Thank you for installing {{ .Chart.Name }}.

Your release is named {{ .Release.Name }}.

The controller and CRDs have been installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

Pod Security Admission: the chart does not own the namespace. Every Ichor pod meets the "restricted"
profile, so enforce it (ADR 0108):

  kubectl label namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted \
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit=restricted pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted

{{- if include "ichor.cnp.enabled" . }}
Network: Ichor's CiliumNetworkPolicies are on for namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} (default deny, one allow per flow; ADR 0100).
{{- if .Release.IsUpgrade }}
NOTICE: an earlier release of this chart did not render them by default. To opt out, set networkPolicy.cilium.enabled=false
(or delete the ciliumnetworkpolicies in the namespace after setting it).
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

To verify the installation:

  kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  kubectl get customresourcedefinitions

To learn more about the release, try:

  $ helm status {{ .Release.Name }} -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  $ helm get all {{ .Release.Name }} -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}

{{- if and .Values.ichorUI.enabled (not .Values.ichorUI.oidc.enabled) (not .Values.ichorUI.users.enabled) }}

{{- if .Values.ichorUI.allowUnauthenticated }}
WARNING: ichor-ui has no sign-in and ichorUI.allowUnauthenticated is true: anyone who can reach it
can make changes with its ServiceAccount's permissions. Enable ichorUI.users or ichorUI.oidc.
{{- else }}
NOTE: ichor-ui has no sign-in, so it serves read-only calls only. Enable ichorUI.users or ichorUI.oidc;
ichorUI.allowUnauthenticated=true restores open writes (an upgrade from before ADR 0108 needs it to keep writing).
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

On a cluster with no CNI the chart refuses to install (preflight.cni): run
`ichor cni bootstrap` first, which installs Ichor Cilium, then install again.
After the install, register the cluster with `ichor adopt`.
